environment: GitHub Actions production deploy and the private attachment filesystem
observer: Codex using GitHub Actions job logs

checks.name: Original failure
checks.detail: The guarded release stopped before installing release files because the attachment filesystem lacked the required free-space reserve.

checks.name: Controlled Docker recovery
checks.detail: The recovery verified that Docker and attachments share a filesystem and that production containers exist, then pruned unused build cache. The image-removal fallback was not needed; no volumes or containers were pruned.

checks.name: Capacity under active uploads
checks.detail: This run measured idle post-rollout headroom, not representative concurrent uploads.
